name: circle
description: Circle Admin API v2 MCP server with 170 tools for community members, spaces, posts, events, courses, messages and workflows.
long_description: Requires eligible Circle Admin API access. All 104 writes require confirmation; read-only exposes 66 reads. Create posts defaults to draft. Every API request and page counts against community usage. Private tokens are never bundled.

api_token.title: Circle Admin V2 API token
api_token.description: Private token from Settings > Developers > Tokens. Leave empty when using a private token file.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Optional absolute regular local token-only file, at most 64 KB. Never bundle it.

auth_scheme.title: Authentication header scheme
auth_scheme.description: Token follows the pinned OpenAPI security scheme. Bearer follows the quick-start prose. No automatic fallback.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed writes
allow_destructive.description: If disabled, refuse all 104 writes even when confirmed.
